Introduction

JJCC, also known as Double JC, was a seven-member boy group under Jackie Chan Group Korea. They debuted on March 24, 2014 with the single "At First". Their name stands for Jackie Chan Joint Cultures. On May 6 2024, Eddy Confirmed they disbanded on an Instagram Story, noting they've been pursuing their own career paths for a while now and decided to terminate their contracts.
